enabled.description: Enable source filtering on the scheduled run and manual invocations.

dryRun.description: Save proposed decisions for review without removing sources or blocking reingestion.

llmEnabled.description: Use the LLM only for suspicious or ambiguous sources; clear noise is handled deterministically.

maxSourcesPerRun.description: Maximum source candidates considered in one run.

maxLLMCallsPerRun.description: Maximum LLM calls in one run. Set to zero to disable LLM review for that run.

maxContentChars.description: Maximum retained content characters shown to the LLM; a truncated review cannot remove a source.

runBudgetSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget for one run, in seconds.

removeConfidence.description: Minimum confidence required for an LLM-backed removal decision.

llmModel.description: Optional chat model override for suspicious-source review.

protectedSourceIds.description: Source IDs that are always protected from removal and reingestion blocking.

protectedUriPatterns.description: Anchored wildcard patterns matched against the full source URI or canonical browser URI.
